analysis: Test-only changes under provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomFanHelperTests. FanDaemonTestHarness.swift (added) extracts the former private harness from FanDaemonTests.swift (base lines 245-455 removed) into a shared internal makeFanDaemonHarness with new options: startupTemperature, startupFanCount, enabled, thermalState. It calls reader.discover(brandString: "Apple M4 Max") (head line 40). The harness also passes new FanDaemon init parameters thermalState: (head line 88), and exposes controller. DaemonBackend gains locking in keyInfo, a keyNotFound path (head line 151), read counters, injected read failures and a blocking read gate (head lines 156-162, 290-306). Test journal writes use owner:nil with requireRootJournalOwnership:false (head lines 89-90, 314), consistent with the base harness and test-only. FanDaemonTests.swift now only renames calls to makeFanDaemonHarness. FanStartupDiscoveryTests.swift was supplied as metadata only (added, content not provided), so it is a coverage gap. Relevant TB-010 and T-044..T-048: the harness implies production FanDaemon changes (thermalState injection, startup discovery, lifecycle during controller suspension) whose sources were not supplied. The integration pass should verify those production changes, which may sit in other batches. Points to check: startup discovery and fan-count handling (T-048 sensor mapping), the journal-before-manual-write ordering (T-046), lease/lifecycle handling while the controller actor is suspended (T-047), and that root journal ownership stays required in production. No security regression is visible in the supplied test code.
